args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

src/money.py used ROUND_HALF_UP despite the docstring and FIN-212
requiring ROUND_HALF_EVEN, causing tests/test_money.py to fail
in the nightly build.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming otherwise.

## Change
- Import `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` and use it in `round_money()`. This means `2.675` rounds to `2.68` and `2.665` rounds to `2.66` (ties round to the even cent), matching the tests.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986`.

Refs: FIN-212
